subject.title: [Bug]: Bootstrap files in agentDir are silently ignored — only workspace directory files are injected into system prompt

question: Should configured per-agent `agentDir` files become bootstrap prompt authority, or should OpenClaw keep workspace-only bootstrap loading and warn when `agentDir` contains ignored bootstrap filenames?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the open fixes choose different trust boundaries for security-critical prompt files; automation should not decide which local directory may supply AGENTS/SOUL instructions.

options.title: Keep workspace-only and warn
options.body: Land a warning/docs path so misplaced `agentDir` bootstrap files are visible while the workspace remains the canonical prompt source.

options.title: Allow explicit agentDir prompt authority
options.body: Land an agentDir-loading path only with explicit precedence, diagnostics, docs, upgrade compatibility, and security proof.

options.title: Ship mitigation and split feature work
options.body: Accept warning-only diagnostics now and track per-agent agentDir bootstrap loading as a separate product/security design item.

recommendation.title: Keep workspace-only and warn
recommendation.body: Land a warning/docs path so misplaced `agentDir` bootstrap files are visible while the workspace remains the canonical prompt source.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest traced history across the bootstrap resolver, workspace bootstrap behavior, and agent runtime docs.
